scenes.title: A boat and Sela's warning
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn agrees to row the party for two silver, refuses night trips, and offers to meet at first light tomorrow. She says Saltmere flooded when the bell first rang forty years ago and repeats her grandmother's account of warm water.

scenes.title: Hymn pages in Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: The party explores the mine and finds warm black floodwater and hymn pages, one marked "M. Brand"; Teo identifies the handwriting as Mira's. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement without confirmation; Oren takes two damage from the bad air.

scenes.title: The fishermen's warning
scenes.place: Shore below the drowned chapel, Gullwick
scenes.summary: Back in Gullwick at dusk, the party visits the shore below the chapel; the exposed ruins include the bell tower and broken arches. A fisherman warns that the Kelp Mother pulls children underwater, which the GM identifies as the fishermen's claim.

scenes.title: The underwater bell at midnight
scenes.summary: At midnight the submerged bell rings twelve times and the humming is louder than two nights earlier; the GM notes the choir clock is at three of six. Pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor underwater, vanish when the bell stops, and the party leaves.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's dive
scenes.summary: The party plans to have Sela row them out at first light and dive to the chapel in daylight at low tide; Vessa plans to buy rope and a second lantern. Bram says he has known Maren for thirty years and that she lost a brother to the bay; the party takes a long rest and returns to full health.
